name: EconML
description: ALICE (Automated Learning and Intelligence for Causation and Economics) is a Microsoft Research project aimed at applying Artificial Intelligence concepts to economic decision making. One of its goals is to build a toolkit that combines state-of-the-art machine learning techniques with econometrics in order to bring automation to complex causal inference problems. To date, the ALICE Python SDK (econml) implements orthogonal machine learning algorithms such as the double machine learning work of Chernozhukov et al. This toolkit is designed to measure the causal effect of some treatment variable(s) t on an outcome variable y, controlling for a set of features x.

name: Voice Agent observability with LangSmith 🌟
description: Caroline di Vittorio, Engineer at LangChain, builds a voice agent with the Google ADK and the Gemini Live model, then sets up tracing in LangSmith to see exactly what the agent is doing under the hood. Gemini Live is Google's native audio model. It's speech-to-speech, taking audio directly as input and producing audio as output without transcribing to text, which keeps latency low and makes the agent's voice sound natural and emotive. What's covered: building a terminal-based weather assistant with two tools, defining the LangSmith Google ADK plugin, registering it on the runner, recording user and agent audio so the trace captures only what the user actually heard, and reading the full trace in LangSmith, including audio playback, transcripts, tool calls, interruption events, and token-level cost breakdowns. Get started with the Gemini Live API. Grab an API key in Google AI Studio and start building. Resources: Gemini Live API docs → https://goo.gle/4hNqR0H Google ADK docs → https://goo.gle/4wc2rSf LangSmith docs → https://goo.gle/4xH0A9l Subscribe to Google for Developers → https://goo.gle/developers What are you building with Gemini Live? name: Computer History in ChatGPT
description: Codex & ChatGPT can now understand the context around what you’re working on. Available in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac for ChatGPT Pro, Business, and Enterprise. If you’re on a Business or Enterprise team, your admin will need to turn it on first.

name: Get a daily CFO briefing with ChatGPT Work
description: Start the day with a clear view of the decisions that matter most. ChatGPT Work brings financial performance, close status, contract risks, and market signals into one CFO briefing. See what changed, identify emerging opportunities, and prioritize decisions across the business. When a potential acquisition surfaces, ChatGPT creates an executive decision memo and an editable Excel workbook covering valuation, financial projections, transaction economics, and risk. See how ChatGPT Work can help your finance team: https://openai.com/business/solutions/finance/

name: Build custom financial forecasting apps with ChatGPT Work
description: Build an interactive financial forecast using the numbers your business already trusts. ChatGPT Work connects approved financial data from Google Drive and NetSuite, compares actuals with the latest outlook, and creates an interactive forecasting dashboard. Adjust assumptions, test scenarios, and see how different decisions could affect the business. Approved figures, proposed adjustments, and hypothetical scenarios stay clearly separate. See how ChatGPT Work can help your finance team: https://openai.com/business/solutions/finance/

name: Reconcile quarter-end financials with ChatGPT Work
description: Prepare for quarter-end close with a clear view of what changed and why. ChatGPT Work connects board materials in Google Drive with posted financial data in NetSuite. It flags variances, traces discrepancies to their source, shows the impact on the forecast, and prepares a close recommendation for Finance to review. When items need attention, ChatGPT turns them into an action plan in Slack with clear owners and next steps. See how ChatGPT Work can help your finance team: https://openai.com/business/solutions/finance/

name: Use ChatGPT Work to deliver board-ready reporting
description: Catch quarter-end mistakes before they reach your board. This is how we use ChatGPT Work to check our financial model, executive memo, and board deck against data. ChatGPT Work will flag anything that doesn’t match for our teams to check. name: You can just launch Sites | ChatGPT Work
description: ChatGPT Work gathers context across your surfaces and helps you go from ambition to action with polished docs, slides, and sites. See how ChatGPT Work builds a structured, shareable launch hub your team can use as a single source of truth—and refine directly before sharing. Learn more about ChatGPT Work: https://openai.com/chatgpt-work/

name: You can just finish the work | ChatGPT Work
description: ChatGPT Work turns your team’s notes, drafts, and ideas into finished work—while you stay in control. See how ChatGPT Work brings together launch results, recap notes, and a Slack thread to build an exec-friendly launch deck you can circulate with leadership. Learn more about ChatGPT Work: https://openai.com/chatgpt-work/

name: How Model ML Uses GPT-5.6 Sol to Get Finance Work Done More Efficiently
description: Model ML is solving the “last-mile problem” in finance, carrying asks from research to analysis to a finished PowerPoint deck or Excel workbook with traceable sources. When Model ML tested GPT‑5.6 Sol in its Composite, the results “blew every metric out the water,” says Co-founder and CEO Chaz Englander: ⚡ 21% fewer tokens per PowerPoint deck than Fable 5 ✅ A 16.6 percentage-point lead over Opus 5 on decks ready for substantive review 📊 36% fewer tokens per Excel workbook than Opus 5 Watch Englander walk through Model ML’s evaluation process, then read the full story about how they use the model in production here: https://openai.com/index/model-ml/

name: How to Schedule a Weekly Metrics Report With ChatGPT Work
description: Stop spending hours pulling together your weekly report. In this step-by-step demo, Eunji from Data Science shows how she sets up a recurring task in ChatGPT Work. Once it’s scheduled, ChatGPT Work pulls the latest metrics, explains what changed, updates the charts, and drafts the Slack message every week—so Eunji starts each Thursday with a complete first draft ready to review. https://chatgpt.com/work/

name: How to Turn a Forecast Spreadsheet Into an Interactive Planning Tool With ChatGPT Work
description: Bring your spreadsheets to life with ChatGPT Work. In this demo, Kyle from Strategic Finance teaches you how to turn your data into an interactive dashboard you can use to compare scenarios and see how numbers change. The best part: you can build it in minutes, without knowing how to code. https://chatgpt.com/work/
